items.how: Applicability working. (Retired: applicability is now worked out automatically from the client's figures.)
steps: Review the entity's status against the CARO exemptions
items.text: CARO applicability confirmed (exemptions for banking, insurance, s.8, OPC, small companies and qualifying private companies).

items.how: Fixed asset register; verification report; title deed list.
steps: Obtain the fixed asset register and verification report
Check title deeds for all immovable property
Enquire about revaluation and benami proceedings
items.text: Records of PPE and intangibles maintained; physical verification done; title deeds in company's name; revaluation; benami proceedings.

items.how: Verification reports; bank stock statements reconciliation.
steps: Review inventory verification reports and discrepancies
Check treatment of differences of 10% or more
Reconcile quarterly bank stock statements with books
items.text: Inventory verified at reasonable intervals; discrepancies of 10% or more dealt with; quarterly stock statements to banks (limits above Rs 5 crore) agree with books.

steps: List loans, advances, guarantees and investments to others
Check terms, regularity of repayment, overdue and renewed amounts
items.text: Loans, advances, guarantees and investments to companies, firms, LLPs and others: terms not prejudicial, repayment regular, overdue amounts, renewals.

steps: Cross-refer to the s.185 / s.186 work in the Companies Act module
items.text: Compliance with s.185 and s.186 for loans, investments, guarantees and security.

steps: Classify loans received under deposit rules
items.text: Deposits and deemed deposits comply with s.73–76 and RBI directions.

steps: Check whether cost records are prescribed
items.text: Cost records maintained where prescribed under s.148(1).

steps: List statutory dues paid late and arrears over 6 months at year end
List disputed dues with the forum
items.text: Statutory dues deposited regularly; arrears over six months at year end; disputed dues with the forum where pending.

steps: Review assessment orders and survey statements
items.text: Income surrendered or disclosed in tax assessments recorded in books.

steps: Check repayment defaults from lender statements
Check end-use of term loans and short-term funds
items.text: Defaults in repayment; wilful defaulter status; term loans used for stated purpose; short-term funds not used for long-term purposes; funds raised for subsidiaries or associates.

steps: Check utilisation of funds from IPO / preferential allotment
items.text: IPO / FPO money and preferential allotments used for stated purposes and comply with s.42 and s.62.

steps: Review the fraud log and whistle-blower complaints
items.text: Fraud noticed or reported; ADT-4 filed; whistle-blower complaints considered.

steps: If a Nidhi company, check net-owned-fund and deposit ratios
items.text: Nidhi company compliance (only if Nidhi).
Related-party transactions comply with s.177 and s.188 and are disclosed.

items.how: Internal audit reports for the year.
steps: Obtain internal audit reports for the year
Assess adequacy of the internal audit
items.text: Internal audit system commensurate with size; internal audit reports considered.

steps: Scan for non-cash transactions with directors
items.text: No non-cash transactions with directors or connected persons in breach of s.192.

steps: Apply the principal business test (assets and income)
items.text: Registration under s.45-IA of RBI Act required or held; CIC status of group.

steps: Compute cash loss for the year and previous year
items.text: Cash losses in the current and immediately preceding year.

steps: Check for any auditor resignation in the year
Review issues raised by the outgoing auditor
items.text: Resignation of statutory auditors during the year and issues raised by them considered.

items.how: Ageing of assets and liabilities; ratios.
steps: Compare assets and liabilities due within one year
items.text: No material uncertainty about meeting liabilities falling due within one year.
Unspent CSR amount transferred to Schedule VII fund or Unspent CSR Account within time.
Qualifications or adverse remarks in CARO reports of group companies (consolidated FS only).
